conversations.title: Postgres connection pool exhausted under load

messages.content: My Next.js app hits 'remaining connection slots are reserved' after a few minutes of traffic. I'm using postgres.js with max: 50 per instance and I run 6 instances.

6 × 50 = 300 connections, but the default Postgres max_connections is 100. Either lower `max` to ~10 per instance or put PgBouncer in transaction mode in front of the database and keep the app-side pools small.

conversations.title: CSS grid: sidebar that stops scrolling with the page

messages.content: How do I make a fixed-width sidebar sticky next to a scrolling main column with CSS grid?
Use `grid-template-columns: 288px 1fr` on the container, then `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; overflow: auto` on the sidebar. The main column scrolls normally and the sidebar stays put.

conversations.title: Rust borrow checker: mutable borrow inside a loop

messages.content: for item in &self.items { self.total += item.cost(); } fails with 'cannot borrow self.total as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable'.

Compute the sum first and assign once: `let sum: u32 = self.items.iter().map(|i| i.cost()).sum(); self.total += sum;`. That ends the shared borrow of `self.items` before the mutable borrow of `self.total`.
My starter smells like nail polish remover after two days in the fridge. Is it dead?

No, it's just hungry. The acetone smell is the yeast producing ethanol and esters once the flour is used up. Discard most of it and feed 1:1:1 twice a day at room temperature; the smell goes back to sour-yeasty within a day or two.
